name: Dawood Ibrahim
real_life_parallel: Real Dawood Ibrahim — D-Company chief; 1993 Bombay bombings mastermind; Karachi-based under ISI protection

biography.background: Founder and leader of D-Company, transnational criminal-terror conglomerate. Mastermind of 1993 Bombay bombings (257 killed). Based in Karachi since 1993 under ISI protection. UN-designated global terrorist.
biography.empire: D-Company: narcotics, arms trafficking, FICN distribution, hawala, real estate, Bollywood financing
biography.state_protection: ISI provides safe haven in Karachi; D-Company serves as operational proxy

risk_profile.description: Institutionalized protection; takes business risks not personal exposure risks

intelligence_signature.communications: Multi-layered; family trusted couriers; minimal electronic exposure
intelligence_signature.pattern: Remains invisible; operates through lieutenants; occasional audio intercepts
